description.text: Objectives Objective of the program aims to provide students with solid theory and the latest knowledge in economics and Chinese culture. The program will increase our students’ Chinese proficiency and international vision, provide solid training in computer skills and cross cultural communication competence. We believe that these skills and solid trainings will allow our students to be internationally competent and assume leadership role in their related fields. Duration Duration of program is 2 years with course works in the first year, followed by a thesis project. Research Areas 1. Industrial Economic Theory and Industrial Policy 2. Trade and Distribution Industry 3. Industrial and Trade Organizations in Southeast Asia 4. Circulation and Consumption of Industrial Products in Southeast Asia Credit Units Students need to successfully complete at least 42 credits. Scholarships 1.The Shenzhen Universiade International Scholarship 2.HITSZ Scholarship

duration.text: The Applied Economics at Harbin Institute of Technology is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4861 USD/per year ￥ 35000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. HITSZ International Student Application Form 2. Highest degree (notarized photocopy) 3. Academic transcripts (notarized photocopy) 4. A study plan (no less than 800 words) 5. Three recommendation letters 6. Photocopy of your Identification Certificate 7. Three passport photos

requirements.text: 1. Aged 18 or above 2. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens in good health. 3. Hold a Bachelor's degree.
